scope_authorization: The organizers authorized publication of all task evaluation code, snapshots, labels, reference solutions, verifier and sidecar assets for user-local evaluation on 2026-11-20.

tasks.evidence: The MSEBench organizers approved redistribution of these three frozen public splits. Source: Kamal Choudhary, JARVIS-DFT 2D dataset (jdft_2d.json), Figshare, Version 8, https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.6815705.v8. MSEBench processed the source structures and derived training, validation and unlabeled public test splits for the exfoliation-energy task, including test representation variants. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Cite the dataset, JARVIS-DFT, and JARVIS-Tools. The organizers also approved public release of the Task 01 instruction, harness contract, dataset metadata and current candidate generation constraints. A separate reuse license has not been specified for these four files. The public metadata copy records the SHA256 of the constraints file shipped in this export.
tasks.license: CC-BY-4.0 (three JARVIS-DFT splits only); separate reuse license unspecified for the four task documents and configuration files

tasks.evidence: The MSEBench organizers confirmed that the listed participant files, including all three Task 10 CSV splits, may be redistributed. Source: Matbench/matminer matbench_expt_gap, originally archived from https://ml.materialsproject.org/projects/matbench_expt_gap.json.gz. Matbench derives this dataset from the supplementary data of Zhuo, Mansouri Tehrani, and Brgoch (2018), DOI: 10.1021/acs.jpclett.8b00124. The MSEBench revision uses deterministic composition splits and stable IDs. The training split contains labels. Validation and public test splits contain features only.
